review_rules: Vivec's in-character statements, developer commentary about Vivec, and community interpretations are separate evidence layers.
The Trial of Vivec preserves participant and role attribution rather than treating the whole roleplay as one authorial voice.
Interpretations of the 36 Lessons must cite the textual passages they depend on.
Symbolic readings are stored as interpretations unless the source explicitly states the proposed meaning.
Later ESO material about Vivec or the Tribunal is linked as independent primary evidence.
